# Website + Online Booking

> A clear small-business website with an online booking calendar built in, so customers can see services and book a time online instead of only calling. Builds start at $249 one-time, with a firm quote in writing before work starts.

Website + Online Booking is a product by Northbeam Builds, a small studio in Austin, TX that builds websites and AI tools for local service businesses. Company site: https://northbeambuilds.com

## What it is

Website + Online Booking — for shop owners with an old website, or no website at all: it’s a clear website where customers can see what you do and book a time online, so the phone isn’t the only way to get a job.

## Who it is for

For: Your shop has no website yet.; Your site is old, slow, or has no way to book.; You lose jobs because booking means calling during work hours.
Not for: Your shop already has a modern website with booking that works.; Your business mainly needs a big online store. That’s a different, bigger build — ask us and we’ll tell you straight.

## Price

From $249 one-time. Most simple sites land at the starting price. You always get a firm quote in writing before we start — the quote is the price.
Buy online (Stripe checkout): https://buy.stripe.com/eVq6oHg3q7xG1S21AWgYU02

## How it works

1. You tell us about your business on one short call — services, hours, prices, service area.
2. We build the website and the booking calendar. You see it and approve it before it goes live.
3. Customers pick a time and book it themselves. You get a notice for every booking — no phone tag.

## What is included

- A clear multi-page website — home, services, about, contact.
- An online booking calendar.
- Booking notices sent to you.
- Your contact info done right everywhere on the page.
- It’s your website and your content — you own it.

## Questions and answers

- Q: Do I own my website?
  A: Yes. Your site, your words, your photos. If you ever leave, it goes with you.
- Q: Can customers really book without calling?
  A: Yes. They pick a real open time from your calendar and get a confirmation. You get a notice right away.
- Q: How long does it take?
  A: We give you a launch date in writing before you pay anything — and the firm quote and the date are the deal.
- Q: What if I already have a website?
  A: We can rebuild it or replace it. If what you have already works, we’ll tell you to keep it.
